reason: FEASIBILITY passes: the dry build exp70n (sha d1379b7d) differs from K2 (1f1ddb6d) only in the cell-0 name comment and one os.environ override. Cell 2 reads the knob and cell 7 uses it (`grandchild_dist - sister_dist < SAFE_DIV_DIVERGE_UM`). It adds no runtime and the metadata is correct. VALUE fails. (1) The claim that the knob 'removes only FP forks' comes from a small lab sample. It is not a property of the gate. I ran the GT-geometry divergence histogram over all 151 train divisions (same logic as tools/division_gate_funnel.py). 35 real divisions are reachable at 2.25. At 2.5, 4 of them are lost (11%): 2 of 9 on 44b6 (22%) and 2 of 26 on 6bba. At 2.75, 9 are lost (26%). On the 6bba ins bed the knob removed 4 of 23 FP forks (17%). Against 11% of TP, that gives the removed band an implied precision of ~0.37, above the metric break-even of 0.265, so removal is negative in expectation under the GT prior. The lab lost 0 TP where ~2.3 were expected (Poisson P ~0.10), so the evidence is mixed and the sign is unresolved. (2) The whole signal is 4 FP events on one embryo. On 44b6, 2.5 changes nothing evaluable on 17 + 71 clips (125 forks removed, all on unannotated cells). The value was picked from ~25 arms plus a plateau grid, so the winner's curse applies to a +0.0007 lab gain. (3) The public estimate is too optimistic. Its own 1/6 rule gives ~+0.0001, and the most likely outcome is an unchanged display. P(<0 | any evaluable change) is closer to 0.3-0.4 than 0.1-0.15. P(display >= 0.955) 0.25-0.35 rests on the 0.95436 team-best figure, which assumes a uniform 0.954 block (scan_hyp_ladder_next.notes l.21). A flip would be mostly noise from 29% of the test, and it says little about private. (4) Rules: under L9, div2.5 is class C and can never be a final. As a public-only rung it has ~0 finals value and uses one of the over-committed 27 Sep slots (plancheck: worst case 7 uses > 5 slots). Making it a final would need a night-time L9 amendment that adds a grid-picked knob to the finals set after 4 rungs are already in flight. That is post-hoc, it goes against the spirit of R8/R9, and the sleeping user has not OK'd it. The private effect on other embryos is ~0 with an unresolved sign, so it cannot beat #37/#38 in any way that matters.
fix: Do not add exp70n/exp70o/exp70j/exp70m to the 27 Sep ladder, and do not amend L9. Put 'safe-div divergence 2.5' on the post-deadline list with this evidence: the lab shows 4 FP / 0 TP removed on 6bba, while the GT prior puts 4 of 35 reachable real divisions in [2.25, 2.5). Only if the informed-combo stage frees a slot with nothing better (after the >= 2 reserve), could exp70n run as an explicitly class-C, public-only information probe with the stated dummy gate. Its result must not enter the finals.
realistic_gain: Public: ~0 to +0.0001 central, sign unresolved (P(<0 | evaluable change) ~0.3-0.4), most likely an unchanged 0.954 display. Private: ~0 +/- 0.0003. Finals value: 0 under L9 as written.
